name: data.kafka
doc:
data.kafka: an Apache Kafka client written in Zell over net and
net.tls (docs/STDLIB.md level 3b). Files of the namespace:

  kafka.zl           wire encoding, record batches v2 (CRC-32C, gzip and
                     zstd), errors, broker connections (ApiVersions,
                     SASL PLAIN / SCRAM-SHA-256 / SCRAM-SHA-512, TLS),
                     the cluster client (metadata cache, leaders,
                     coordinators, retries with backoff)
  kafka_producer.zl  Producer: batching by size and linger, acks,
                     idempotence (producer id + sequences), partitioners
  kafka_consumer.zl  Consumer: consumer groups (range / round-robin
                     assignors, rebalances, heartbeats in a background
                     task, auto or manual commits), fetching
  kafka_admin.zl     Admin: create, delete, list and describe topics

Protocol versions (all non-flexible, so that one encoder covers them):
ApiVersions 0, Metadata 1, Produce 7 (3 on brokers without it), Fetch 10
(4), ListOffsets 1, FindCoordinator 1, JoinGroup 2, SyncGroup 1,
Heartbeat 1, LeaveGroup 1, OffsetCommit 2, OffsetFetch 1, SaslHandshake
1, SaslAuthenticate 0, CreateTopics 2, DeleteTopics 1, InitProducerId 0.
They are inside the ranges of Kafka 1.0 through 4.x; zstd needs Produce 7
and Fetch 10 (Kafka >= 2.1). snappy and lz4 batches are not supported
(producing them is refused, consuming them fails with an error).

items.name: AssignRange
items.signature: func AssignRange(members map[string][]string, partitions map[string]int) map[string][]TopicPartition
items.doc:
The range assignor: for each topic, its partitions split into
contiguous ranges over the members subscribed to it (sorted by id; the
first ones get one more when it does not divide).
items.summary: The range assignor: for each topic, its partitions split into contiguous ranges over the members subscribed to it (sorted by id; the first ones get one more when it does not divide).

The round-robin assignor: every (topic, partition), sorted, dealt in

items.name: DecodeBatches
items.signature: func DecodeBatches(raw []byte, topic string, partition int) []Batch!
items.doc:
Decodes the record batches in data (a fetch response's records or a
produce request's); a truncated last batch is ignored (the broker cuts
the response at max bytes). Batches of magic 0/1 are skipped. CRCs are
checked.
items.summary: Decodes the record batches in data (a fetch response's records or a produce request's); a truncated last batch is ignored (the broker cuts the response at max bytes).

items.name: EncodeBatch
items.signature: func EncodeBatch(records []Record, baseOffset int, codec int, level int, prod BatchProducer) []byte!
items.doc:
Encodes records as one record batch (magic 2) starting at offset
baseOffset: CRC-32C over attributes..end, records compressed with codec
0 (none), 1 (gzip) or 4 (zstd) at level (0: the codec's default).
items.summary: Encodes records as one record batch (magic 2) starting at offset baseOffset: CRC-32C over attributes..end, records compressed with codec 0 (none), 1 (gzip) or 4 (zstd) at level (0: the codec's default).
